title: Fivebrane Filtrations and Holomorphic Field Theories
exact_target: Identify every proposed fivebrane-filtration level with its predicted holomorphic field theory for all integers greater than one.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005076 (OWR-9790367-007). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Recent Developments in Representation Theory and Mathematical Physics (2022), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2022/16, pp. 817--848. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The filtration itself is conjectural. Constructing it and explaining what equivalence of holomorphic theories means are part of the requested identification, rather than assumed completed results.
